Theorem
[Cheeger--Yau heat-kernel comparison] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0426, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0427 ↗ thm:chow-ii-heat-kernel-uniqueness-lower-ricci 1. appe:1.16\group Heat Kernels

If $\operatorname {Rc}\ge (n-1)K$, then \[ h(x,y,t)\ge H_{n,K}(d(x,y),t), \] where $H_{n,K}$ is the radial heat kernel of the simply connected space form of sectional curvature $K$.
